analysis.title: Kimco Realty Corp. (KIM) 3Q26 Update: Continued strength in SS with additional upside from capital recycling
key_insights: KIM reported 3Q26 FFO/share of $0.47 on 10/29/26, 2.2% above GSe and 2.6% above FactSet consensus of $0.46.

KIM raised 2026 FFO/share guidance to $1.84-$1.86, versus GSe/consensus at the time of $1.84/$1.83. Drivers cited: 3Q results, stronger same-store NOI expectations, better visibility into rent commencements, leasing trends and lower bad debt assumptions.
GS raised its 2026 FFO/share estimate to $1.85 (from $1.83), implying 5.7% y/y growth, and raised 2027 to $1.95 (from $1.92) and 2028 to $2.05 (from $2.03 in Exhibit 5).

Same-store NOI growth accelerated to +4.9% in 3Q26 from +3.5% in 2Q26, driven by a 3.2% increase in minimum rents and better expense recoveries. FY26 same-store NOI guidance was raised to +3.5%-3.8% from +3.0%-3.5%, and the credit-loss assumption was tightened to 50-60bps from 55-75bps.

The signed-not-opened (SNO) spread narrowed 10bps q/q to 390bps, with $76mn of future annual base rent yet to commence versus $75mn in 2Q26. About $64mn (~85%) is scheduled to commence from 4Q26 through 2027, giving embedded growth visibility into 2027.

Management expects $34mn of rent from 2026 commencements, nearly 20% above its original expectation. GS's read is that management did not yet commit to changing how it calculates 2027 guidance on the back of this timing success.

Economic occupancy rose 30bps q/q to 92.7%. Leased occupancy hit an all-time high of 96.6% (+20bps q/q, +90bps y/y). Small-shop occupancy held at a record 92.9%, and anchor occupancy rose to 98.2% (+40bps q/q, +120bps y/y).
Blended pro-rata rent spreads were +12.0% in 3Q26 (new leases +31.5%, renewals +7.3%, options +7.7%). On a trailing-four-quarter basis the blended spread was +12.4%.

Capital recycling: YTD pro-rata dispositions were $391mn at a 5.1% weighted-average cap rate versus $118mn of acquisitions at a 5.8% cap rate. The FY26 transaction-volume outlook was raised to $400-$500mn from $300-$500mn, with expected acquisition/disposition cap rates of ~6.0%/~5.0%.

Post-quarter, KIM bought two grocery-anchored centers in Louisville for $295mn at a low-6% blended cap rate, more than 100bps above its 2026 disposition cap rate, with ~4% annual NOI growth underwritten over 10 years. GS has less visibility on reaching transaction targets than on same-store growth, but says the recent updates have helped the stock.

KIM repurchased 6.3mn common shares for $150mn at an average $23.81 in 3Q26 and about $74mn of preferred stock. Net debt/consolidated EBITDA fell to 5.0x from 5.2x, and KIM repaid $266mn of unsecured notes in 3Q plus a $500mn 2.80% note after quarter-end.
Structured investments saw about $76mn of net repayments in 3Q26 ($38.8mn deployed versus $114.6mn repaid), and KIM made two more structured investments totaling ~$49mn after quarter-end.

Call takeaways: management cited traffic up ~3% y/y, consolidated NOI margin above 70% for the first time in nearly a decade, G&A at 5.2% of revenue YTD versus 5.4% in 2025, and lease cycle times down ~30% q/q under the One Kimco efficiency program.

Valuation: KIM trades at 13.0x NTM FFO, a -31% discount to REITs versus a -11% ('12-'15) and -30% ('17-'19) historical average discount. On NTM AFFO it trades at 17.6x, a -20.0% discount versus -2.1% and -14.7% historically.

GS keeps a Neutral rating and raised its 12-month price target to $26.00 from $24.00 (3.7% upside from $25.07), based on a 17.5x target Q5-Q8 AFFO multiple (from 16.2x). KIM trades at 17.7x GS NTM AFFO.

market_movers.rationale: PT raised to $26 from $24 on a higher 17.5x target AFFO multiple (from 16.2x) after estimates rolled forward. Rating stays Neutral with 3.7% upside.

sector_views.rationale: GS sees strong same-store growth and leasing at KIM but keeps a Neutral rating, with the stock near its $26 target.

earnings_insights: KIM 3Q26 FFO/share reported 10/29/26: $0.47 versus GSe $0.46 (2.2% above) and FactSet consensus $0.46 (2.6% above).
KIM 2026 FFO/share guidance raised to $1.84-$1.86 versus GSe $1.84 and consensus $1.83 at the time. GS new 2026 estimate is $1.85 (old $1.83), 5.7% y/y growth, versus FactSet consensus $1.83.

GS 2027 FFO/share estimate $1.95 (old $1.92), 5.3% growth, versus FactSet consensus $1.92. GS 2028 estimate is $2.05 in Exhibit 5 (old $2.03) versus FactSet consensus $1.99, which GS puts 3.2% above consensus.
3Q26 same-store NOI growth +4.9% versus +3.5% in 2Q26. FY26 same-store NOI guidance raised to +3.5%-3.8%.
Next quarter's FFO/share estimates from GS: 4Q26E $0.47, 1Q27E $0.48, 2Q27E $0.49.
risk_factors: Deterioration in the open-air retail environment with more retailer bankruptcies, including struggling national chains and local retailers.
Lower demand for space, leading to slower occupancy gains and lower leasing spreads.
A slower transaction market limiting accretive capital recycling or narrowing investment spreads.
